notes.title: The Burst version 1.0.32 is out!
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings operatives![/h1]

I come bearing great news! We now have full bHaptics support!
That's right! Now you can feel everything that poor Hornet feels! Getting shot, falling into the abyss, blowing up, crashing your mirage into a ton of explosives! Sounds like an amazing experience! Right?

Oh, and by the way, there's a whoooole lot of other things we cooked with this new version! One of those things are... ACHIEVEMENTS!!! That's right, they're finally here! Also we've done some requested enemy improvements and much, [i]MUCH[/i] more!

Anyways, im sure you're curious about what exacrlty we did and what feedback we implemented, so here's a full list of everything!

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]

[list]
[*] Armor debris collision is fixed — the player can no longer stand on armor pieces
[*] ACHIEVEMENTS
[*] Enemy accuracy is now range-dependent
[*] Enemies now react faster if they lose sight of the player
[*] Enemies now play turn animations correctly

[*] Some enemies were mistakenly unhookable before. Not anymore.
[*] Melee enemies that can push now look for cover if the player is unreachable
[*] Took away teleportation tricks from enemies. Now they jump over obstacles properly.

[h2]Level Art[/h2]

[list]

[list]

notes.title: VISUAL UPDATE IS FINALLY HERE

[h1]Operatives![/h1]

I’m pleased to finally announce that the [b]Visual Update[/b] for [b]THE BURST[/b] is now [b]LIVE[/b]!

Hope you didn’t have to wait for too long! To sweeten the pill a 25% discount is available starting today, [b]October 4th, 10 AM PDT[/b] and will last for 14 days!

As we promised, almost every aspect of the game was enhanced in one way or another: gameplay, level art, graphics and effects!

We also delivered on our other promise - [b]THE UPDATED DEMO FOR THE BURST WILL GO LIVE TODAY[/b] just a bit later, hour-two most.

Jump on your Mirage, greet Shelldogs with rapid fire as they finally leave the Damag rehab center and touch THE NEW AND IMPROVED WALL!

Bug fixes, bot behavior improvements, lots of environmental detailing, but that is not all.

The Burst now supports [b]bHaptics[/b]! Even more immersion for an epic postapocalyptic experience! We will be adding more events to the already existing list in upcoming patches. Feel free to send your feedback to us!

Unfortunately, the long-awaited achievements will have to wait a little bit… They are almost here, but as some of them require a bit more tuning, we will be sure to add them over the course of the next week.

notes.title: The creation of Mirages!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello everyone. [/h2]
I've noticed a lot of talk about mirages lately, so why not delve deeper into them and how they came to be?

If you ask one of our programmers, who basically created the one and only reverse trike from scratch, he would probably say something like: “I was told to do it and I did it. And it slaps.” 

For serious though — At first we actually wanted to implement a vehicle that would glide across the sand using a sail, but ended up going for a reverse tricycle, since it was more... [i]versatile[/i].

We began with a bunch of prototypes with a different number of wheels, casings - some of them looked like a full on buggy with four wheels, metal roof and multiple seats. We got rid of the roof, additional wheels (at some point the seats followed), and we even had some prototypes that looked like sleds!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43770973/61cde196bd219e8d386c6e20683e0fecabb5efa0.jpg[/img]

First we swapped front wheels with sleds, then we wanted something cooler, so we slapped on [i][b]jet engines![/b][/i]
Buuut... that didn't go as planned, so we reverted to more... [i]Damag-ish[/i] technologies - [b]fans![/b] However, they started looking too much like [i]some totally unrelated hovering machine[/i]... 
[i][strike]There were prototypes that even looked like a modern day drones but we don't talk about that...[/strike][/i]

Eventually, it all came down to the reverse trike we all know and love today! Unfortunately, the problems didn't stop there. What about combat? What about all those wild chases? Well, believe it or not, but at first you just had to [i][b]ram[/b][/i] the guys you didn't like and pray for survival. We even considered adding a bunch of guns to the front of the trike, slap couple of mines here and there... [i]you know.[/i]

[img]https://media0.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExM3gwMGZudWl0bnJmNW8yOWI1aDMzd2NzdWEydjYzbm9mazBkZ3k0ZiZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/3J2Z83THYUBvlU3joh/giphy.gif[/img]

But then it struck! Why don't we use... [i][b]GUNS[/b][/i]??? [i]Like... regular guns[/i]. After this shocking revelation, we had our top men working on it for seven billion years and the results speak for themselves!

Anyways, that's gonna be all for today! Stay tuned for more, operatives!

notes.title: UPCOMING UPDATES!
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings operatives![/h2]

Let’s have a little talk about all the current milestones of our Roadmap for The Burst. You’ll see what our team is up to right now and what to expect in the upcoming months. It’s a bit more complicated than just “we are fixing things” and expands on the whole “visual update” we are planning for this beloved child of ours. This time we'll cover...

[h1]GENERAL TWEAKING AND TINKERING[/h1]

[h2]    [b]Critical bug fixes[/b]. Basically, what we were doing all this time anyway (and will keep on doing). That includes but isn’t limited to:[/h2]
[list]
[*] [i]Crashes, optimization stuttering, nasty visual and audio bugs.[/i]
[*] [i]Going out of bounds, misplaced kill volumes and soft-locks.[/i]
[/list]

[h2]    The [b]AI[/b] in general will go through a lot of fine-tuning. As its improvement will be gradual, you’ll see some of it first-hand even before the content patch rolls out. The improvements mentioned will address some enemy AI issues such as navigation and behavior:[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]Navigation[/b]: those of you who played our Demo might have noticed a downgrade in bot positioning and movement. The main reason for it is the seamless nature of the game — it utilizes a more complex navigational system than the standalone Demo/Prologue chapter. As of right now we are both fixing current navigation as it is and adding new pathing for bots to exclude any possibility of them getting stuck in a navigational bottleneck, so they could figure out optimal or alternative routes during the shootouts. All in all the upcoming changes will also affect enemy animations.
[*] [b]Behavior[/b]: Shelldogs (and other enemies) are currently in rehab after overdosing on entfant flesh. Enemy reactions to the player will be changed to match the bot’s role on the battlefield for them to coincide with a logical layout of their squad. In addition to fixing the AI’s indifference to the player, navigational mishaps and clumsy self-detonating grenadiers, we plan on making enemies more recognizable as members of their subclass. Right now it is common for players to not discern different types of enemies from one another. It will change in the near future, however — all enemies will have a class behavior pattern: shooters with a decent range will be less mobile and remain at advantageous positions, while assault units will force close quarters combat with the player. 
[/list]

    [h2]And one of the last, but not the least:[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]Weapon rebalancing[/b] and improvements focusing on [b]Mirage fights[/b] (some of them you might have already noticed)
[*] [b]Hook targeting[/b] enhancement and swinging mechanic tweaking.
[/list]

That's going to be all for today! See you next time, where we'll look into the details of the [i]visual update[/i]! ;)

notes.title: The Burst Q&A
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings operatives.[/h1]

[h2]A week ago we started collecting questions to answer in our Q&A. 
You seem to know a lot about The Burst already, huh? Well, not all of you, so here are some answers:[/h2]

[list]
[*][b]Will there ever be free story dlc / paid content?[/b]
We are not planning any DLCs as separate 'downloadable content' yet.  But as you may know we are planning at least two new game modes, which are still under wraps, although I'm pretty sure we'll have something to show you soon enough ;)

[*][b]What was your scariest moment when the game released?[/b]
It wasn't particularly scary, more like very... embarrassing. We couldn't bring the game to its desired state in the given time.

[*][b]When jump button?[/b]
We have heard your request and added it to the list of features requested by players. We can't say exactly when we'll be able to implement it, but rest assured, we remember about it <3

[*][b]What was the most difficult thing during the development?[/b]
Development in itself isn't easy, especially when work as a team. People need to be guided in the right direction, you have to acknowledge the limits you can push your project to. 
Some features require a lot of time and effort and the AI… Don't even get me started on it.

[*][b]Who is the woman you play as in the prologue?[/b]
Nova is a rebel who comes from one of the UCE unruly colonies. Her role is to show the player the hook and jet-belt capabilities that "K" kindly provides her with. You'll see her at Bordergate though.

[*][b]How many unique endings are there?[/b]
There are 6 of them. Or 4 if you don't take variations into account. However, even variations have their own afterscene and monologue, so in my mind it counts as a legitimate ending.
[strike][i]No spoilers though ;)[/i][/strike]

[*][b]Could the game`s setting be considered grimdark, and will there be lore of what is outside the prison planet?[/b]
There is some lore indicating it, but you will have to look around to find out the exact details, as well as some social and political homages.

[*][b]Can you tell us a little bit more on the lore/ the world order in the game?[/b]
The colony planet Damag experienced an all-out nuclear war about 40 years ago. It hasn’t recovered since, but considering that Damag is the only planet where people can mine a resource called Amplinium, something had to be done. So the United Coalition of Earth turned Damag into a penal colony planet. Convicts are sent here indefinitely to mine resources and trade them for food, water and other supplies. Saying that the universe itself experienced an apocalypse isn’t right. The planet did. And you will bear witness to the consequences of human greed.
[/list]

And that's going to be all for today, operatives. 
See you later!

This technocrat faction is loyal to the Agreement with the UCE. Boomboys send most of the chemicals and explosives up the space bridges. They are cautious around strangers and aren’t known for having a friendly attitude.

Now some entries on their hierarchy:

[list]
[*][b]Techpresidents [/b]— twin brothers, who held the manufacturing presidium office before the war. They survived the blast in their bunker with the help of cryostasis.
[*][b]Obercurators [/b]— serve as mayors and overseers for settlements, but unlike simple curators can command troops. 
[*][b]Techkillers [/b]— top-ranking States of Progress military officials. They wield heavily modified weapons and upgraded armor.
[*][b]Curators [/b]— traders and merchants managing mines, small settlements or factory departments. Former engineers, scientists, foremen. 
[*][b]Boomboys [/b]— The best of them have several Boombangs to command.
[*][b]Boombangs[/b] —  Unhinged. Extremely volatile.
[/list]

notes.content:
Greetings operatives. We are faced with a noteworthy threat. The megagang known as...
[h2]The Shelldogs.[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43770973/03b02f029324b68dee1227ddb46dd8a0887db1b5.png[/img]
A matriarchal religious megagang, with over ten thousand members. Firearms violence is elevated, preached as a virtue. Xenophobia is rampant among the Shelldogs — they would seek to dominate and degrade anyone outside of their cult

[i]“Dogs of the wastes! Behold the miracles of our Divine, in his grace blessing us for our gifts! Let our raids be fruitful, let our shells cover the wastes! In the name of Gunpowder and Lead!”[/i] - words of a Bulletpriestess, Embrasure II

Though mostly loyal and obedient, Shelldogs are prone to unpredictable behavior. One day they call our spacebridges "Heavencanes" and praise Damag's moon as their Wolfgod, the other - blow one of them up,  halting trade in the region.

It would be useful to learn more on the gang's hierarchy, before you are sent to Damag, operative. Here is an excerpt from our archive:

[list]
[*] Mega-bitch or [b]Utopia[/b] — the head of the Shelldogs.
[*] [b]Shellpriestesses[/b] and [b]Bulletpriestesses[/b] take on general and chaplain duties. “Bullets” focus on all-out onslaught, while “Shells” cover logistics.
[*] [b]Varg[/b] is the highest rank a male can achieve. It is basically equal to a senior officer/ colonel. Sometimes their lacking strategic and combat abilities are more than compensated by their libido and good looks. There are exceptions, however - [b]Utopia’s Varg[/b] is not to be trifled with.
[*] [b]Beta wolf[/b] is a rank equivalent to junior officer. They are experienced fighters and clawed their way to this rank through gunfights, raids and missions. 
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43770973/3a1627f564c822b18edfd6f5c4d756d2aa0e292c.jpg[/img]
Though other gang members are commonly known as just [b]dogs[/b], underestimate them at your own peril. They still outnumber you, operative.

And always remember your mission, agent - track down Utopia and cut her down. With you as the protector of the UCE's assets, the rebellion on Damag surely won't last. Good luck.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43770973/006ce71b4238a45e874a482b78984e7ef63192c7.png[/img]

[h2][b]Hello, agents![/b][/h2]
[h3][b]Today we are going to talk about the Sting - your trusty pistol and the best friend in the desolate desert of Damag.[/b][/h3]

[h3]Lore[/h3]

So first of all, what is the Sting?

The Sting is your very own weapon that you [b]cannot lose under any circumstances[/b]. It will be with you from start to finish. Furthermore, you will have [b]unlimited ammo[/b], so you don't have to worry about being unarmed in a sticky situation.

So where do you get such a marvelous weapon? Well, let's take a look at this lore excerpt:

"[i]...The standard issue UCE gun that is meant for operatives sent to distant colony planets. Unlike the conventional weapons, Sting is not dependent on ammo. This model utilizes amplinium batteries and is effective on the long run...[/i]"

There is more to it, of course, but you will have to play the game to find out.

[h3]Upgrades[/h3]

Throughout the game you will find upgrades for the Sting. You will hear a loud beeping signal, the light on your weapon will start to flash and all you need to do is to touch the upgrade box with the Sting.

[img]https://media2.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExbHJ1ejFzZDVtOG5rYzR6Mnd5ZWlvcGQ4MTRscGN3dzY4djZzN3M5cyZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/yZn9JPSTMmnSCEMrCg/giphy.gif[/img]

So what kind of upgrades can you expect? Well, I don't want to spoil the surprise, but I'm gonna share this gif with you and let you guess :B1:

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExOXpjcXF4eGZxZGhodjJhbng5eGgwd3ZlejJ3M2llaHcwOXFxNXJ2ZCZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/PPgHgVaJuiLS5VhmPY/giphy.gif[/img]

[h3]Special Effects[/h3]

A lot of things changed during the development of The Burst, and The Sting is no exception. One of the most obvious changes is the tracer effect. Let's take a look!

[img]https://media4.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExY2VkYjU2a2pkOHk3ZjExZ3FtaGNhMzR0dTl6czIzd3IzbTFwbDAxciZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/pyWLL59EXO915BofPf/giphy.gif[/img]

[i]Second iteration. A thick, but still pale blue beam.[/i]

[img]https://media3.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExOTNicGw2ZDM4bWw0Y3F2NHZiczJ5OGlseDBrMmg1Y25mYjR6eGJmOCZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/7CJBwD6iZCe6qo5ShB/giphy.gif[/img]

notes.title: Demo Patch #1 NOW LIVE!
notes.content:
[h2]Player Character[/h2]
- You can run on more walls now.
- The animation for standing up after landing on the high ground became smoother.
- You can now lean over objects.
- Objects are easier to grab now.
- You are less likely to slip after landing on the edge of a platform.
- Removed two of Nova's voicelines in the last section of the demo

[h2]Optimization[/h2]
- Improved CPU performance for the grappling hook.
- Improved CPU performance for explosive barrel VFX.

[h2]Graphics[/h2]
- The demo now uses DirectX 12 (Shader Model 6) instead of DirectX 11.

[h2]Interactions[/h2]
- Fixed some grappling hook interactions with levers, rings and hooks.
- Broken props and joints will no longer stay attached to the grappling hook.
- Chipper (enemy secondary weapon) has several new grip positions.
- Supply crates are now easier to break.
- Rope physics are more stable and predictable.

[h2]Input[/h2]
- Added an option to toggle the grip button for climbing and grabbing.
- Made it harder to trigger false grip on Index Controllers.
- Increased the slide window before landing after falling from great height.
- Menu can now be accessed by pressing the Right Menu on HTC Vive.
- You can now Jump by pressing the Right Trackpad Down on HTC Vive.
- You can now eject a magazine by pressing the Right Trackpad Up on HTC Vive
- Fixed a visual bug that affected “Controls” menu input for HTC Vive Controllers.
- Fixed a bug when a grappling hook would activate randomly while swinging.

[h2]Level Design[/h2]
- Certain pits or falls will trigger your death properly now.
- Parkour sections before the hideout received some visual improvement.
- Mirage (vehicle) won’t get stuck on the ramp before the hideout.
- Some cave textures were redesigned.
- Several minor visual bugs were fixed.

[h2]Tutorials[/h2]
- Several tutorial videos were tweaked. Removed the sound of the tutorial window closing.
- The currently active tutorial will not affect other tutorials anymore.
- Added a line describing the Turn Mode in the tutorial.

[h2]Enemies[/h2]
- Only staggered enemies can now be thrown on spikes.
- Enemies will now properly follow the player’s position.
- Enemies will now become aggressive after being hit with a weapon in melee.
- Minor AI improvements.
- Enemies will no longer die when their armor piece falls into a pit.
- Improved the AI logic for the last segment of the game. Drivers got their license.
- Enemies no longer get stuck on one of the arenas.
- Enemies now reach for their holster before equipping a new weapon.
- Added SFX and VFX when enemies get spiked.
- Added additional SFX for enemies receiving damage in melee.

So I'm going to address the elephant in the room:

Yes, you can run on almost any wall in the game. If it's vertical and looks flat enough, you can run on it. 
[img]https://media2.giphy.com/media/vWi4JX6m2OUzM6mbnI/giphy.gif[/img]
[i]This wall isn't even that flat[/i]


So how do you actually perform a wall run in The Burst? It's quite simple! Start running, then hop onto the wall and just keep on going. Don't forget to swing your arms!
[img]https://media0.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExcXd1bDV4NG4wZHY3NnlwYWZhdmh0YXc4eHo2cDgyZjc3enJ6eHhtcyZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/2rqSYelMVPJjJ3Fod8/giphy.gif[/img]

[img]https://media2.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExdzRlcThxZm10bGhueHA4b2kxNWNwY3B5c2I5bDE5bHkzY3dhNG5mNCZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/0TkDntwqhrat5KcIW1/giphy.gif[/img]

[img]https://media1.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExaTJ5ZWp1aThmNHd3NzF3Zm9tb3BkNXcxbmtnNjZ4azJ0bW4zNDR2biZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/0A0XzNmABX49s1fGxo/giphy.gif[/img]

[*] [b]Pick up various objects and weapons.[/b]
Whether it's a dirty mug or a bottle...
[img]https://media2.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExNDZwMm5qczcwbDdqZW1qa2tybTk0MjA0cmNzYzVkaDVtMHJyOGJhYyZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/4mol4fnypf26Xe6KU9/giphy.gif[/img]


...or a fresh SMG—your hook will never let you down![img]https://media4.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExa3ZjMTZlcnl4cm9la3Zvd2dmc244am5xaDhqZ3J6MDh1bTR6MnMxeiZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/jbSXGtqupeuDk1i0zY/giphy.gif[/img]
[i]Think of all the possibilities in the heat of the fight![/i]


[*] [b]Let your surroundings work for you.[/b]
Use your hook to explode those suspicious red barrels in the face of your enemies...
[img]https://media4.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExdjlmaTZ0bXZiMXp0d2xma2pqMzgydWd3bHpzamhheDcxbG0yNmxtciZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/hOqxl3PF0onfgMY0Pq/giphy.gif[/img]

...or let a bunch of steel pipes fall on their heads. No matter what you choose, you're gonna deal some real damage.
[img]https://media1.giphy.com/media/c9LaKkcWu66vyZ93UQ/giphy.gif[/img]
[i]They never knew what hit them[/i]


[*] [b]Mess with your enemies.[/b]
Forget about items and barrels. You can even use your hook directly on your foes!
Steal their guns straight from their hands...
[img]https://media4.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExYmE4NXRlcTRkaXBjbjcwNml0OHFqZGY1OW8waHp6YWxoMGdrcjRpNyZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/ZU13mzUG8doNME9Q7v/giphy.gif[/img]


...or pull them towards certain death. No escape!
[img]https://media4.giphy.com/media/ij2BLSj9hl9d21rgLK/giphy.gif[/img]
[i]Another game with deadly pits and spikes. Classic![/i]


[*] [b]Glide through the air.[/b]
And of course, last but not least, your grappling hook can act as a movement tool. You can use it to grapple onto hooks and other specific objects to swing around with no problem! 
[img]https://media3.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExZ3I3dWRvNHkyazN1cmpjeG0yOXphYnIxY3c4ZmppbTU1ZWdhNmd3eCZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/TM16HlNRMR2XZ9ReoP/giphy.gif[/img]
[i]Sounds fun, right!?[/i]

[/list]
In conclusion, there are many ways to use your grappling hook. And we may have even more in the future, so be sure to follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/Gorapid_Studio]Twitter[/url] and join our [url=https://discord.gg/ABkxTAQkPQ]Discord[/url] community, so you won't miss out on any news.
Until next time, agents ːB1ː

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43770973/2a0846098a5d5fa4f4413a0d9d5ac74641d20120.png[/img]

[h2][b]Hello, agents.[/b][/h2]
[h3][b]Today we're going to talk about climbing.[/b][/h3]

So how do you do it? Very simple!
Just put your hands on a ledge, hold down the grip button or sensor, and pull yourself up!
[img]https://media0.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExcDVocHJ2YTBmZTRuOG5xbW1xaGJsMWU3djBmMDNnaXY2eXI4dHk3cSZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/qpe8Aq53deqyxlqvoY/giphy.gif[/img]
[i]See? Easy![/i]


Sounds simple enough, right? Because it is!
[img]https://media1.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExcGZobHB4aGZ1MGFnMXY3YWhpaDdrZ3V1MTFwNDJqdHF5eHpwd29lbCZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/I7ltuQ1iv7y2JxAHb0/giphy.gif[/img]
[i]Just do it![/i]


Climbing is just one of the many ways to get around in the game. And it's probably the one you'll use the most.
[img]https://media2.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExdW16cXExN2JsdnQ2dnhraG9jdDR6Zm5tYXM5bTl0NDg5ejg4eXp6NSZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/D6j8DaG7re1VL01lky/giphy.gif[/img]
[i]Why these elevators are always out of order?[/i]


You're in great shape, so you don't get tired at all. Now go ahead and climb that ladder!
[img]https://media3.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExMGx2MzZ2azRoNmY2eWk1cGJoeGFtdHYyMjRsZTI4dnBzcmp6dmg0bCZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/Yuf4pA3IBsTa7qcHcP/giphy.gif[/img]
[i]It could've been any other ledge, really![/i]

No hesitation!*

notes.title: The Two Sides
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43770973/ec95588e8d2042c18b0688047c9b0fa59d26f7e3.png[/img]

[h2][b]Hello, agents.[/b][/h2]
[h2][b]Today we're going to take a look at the two factions you'll encounter in the world of The Burst.[/b][/h2]

[h2][b]Let's begin![/b][/h2]

[h3][b]Shelldogs[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43770973/03b02f029324b68dee1227ddb46dd8a0887db1b5.png[/img]
Religious barbarians, absolute nutjobs praying to their God-Wolf and whatnot. Really reverent about their ammo and weapons, treating them like religious artifacts. Could be one of the reasons why their arsenal actually works.

Through their fiery speeches and hallucinogenic entfant juice, Shelldogs recruit most of the able-bodied newcomers, allowing them to "wake up" and see the world for what it is. The weak, however, are shot on sight without a chance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43770973/227f655feb65bb21c0f1da792edf33e68b7848b8.jpg[/img]
[i]Shelldog concept art.[/i]

Surprisingly enough, The Shelldogs are a matriarchal society. Led by the Mega-Bitch (yes, that's a real title) and her five advisors, thousands of lower ranked males are being sent out to raid, pillage and kill in the name of their beloved leader.

Through sheer numbers and aggressive behavior, they have quickly become a force to be reckoned with. 

[h3][b]Boomboys[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43770973/392acd6d19d41aed85701ab637b805b71624dda1.png[/img]
The proud army of The States of Progress.

One of the biggest organizations on the planet founded by the former workers and engineers from the first wave of colonization. As a result, Boomboys have established The States of Progress, a capitalist technocratic government overseen by the Techpresident.

The Boomboys, unlike the Shelldogs, can be considered a neutral faction on the planet. Despite their intimidating appearance, they [i]mostly[/i] resort to the use of force in self-defence. Mistaking them for your friends, however, can easily prove fatal.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43770973/a89ceca3a811d4a75f7e8ec67b7cd91d357cdf7c.jpg[/img]
[i]Boomboy concept art.[/i]

The States of Progress at its core is largely made up of former colonists, while many of the lower class workers have been replaced by convicts who were lucky enough not to fall prey to other gangs.

Most members of The States of Progress are forced to work tirelessly in treacherous conditions with little rest just to have a chance at survival. As almost every worker suffers from severe chronic radiation poisoning, the only way to live is to be shortlisted for cryo-treatment.

As for the less fortunate folks, even on the verge of death from radiation, they are still given a chance to serve The States and perform perhaps the most heroic act of all.


Make sure you remember this well, agents. You never know when you might need this information.
Still have questions? Send 'em over to our [url=https://discord.gg/ABkxTAQkPQ]Discord[/url] or [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2073880/discussions/]Steam Forums[/url], whichever you prefer!
Until next time!

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43770973/904aa0276c1b8d4fcb7ab60b17c46fd863336ed9.png[/img]

[h2][b]Hello, agents.[/b][/h2]
[h3][b]Wanna see something cool and exciting?[/b][/h3]

Let me introduce you to our [b]Mirage![/b]
[img]https://media4.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExYjRuMGF4emlsMGcwNGxzam1pZHF2MXcycHRsejRyazRsN2VoNGk4diZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/YgieUyOZEXNHKLIkMf/giphy.gif[/img]

[i]A reverse trike? In my VR game?![/i]


In the world of The Burst, you may often find yourself in a situation where you need to get somewhere fast. That's where the Mirage comes in.
[img]https://media0.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExMW5ia2l6NWFqeXdycWt0Y3g1ZWJncnNxNW5peGF4b3VsdzU5OGR4cSZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/nYm9Q0avdtCki89qLa/giphy.gif[/img]

[i]A hairpin turn? No problem![/i]


Hop on and enjoy the ride at the speed of light!
[img]https://media2.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExaWFuMmRnaGQxNWdwd24zdDBsdGlyM3FnMXIzMDhjazFnM252NGZydyZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/qrJCAYfj8XaT8HxnJY/giphy.gif[/img]

[i]Or maybe just around 70 km/h.[/i]


Enjoy the apocalyptic views of a civilization long gone.
[img]https://media4.giphy.com/media/YMiUra6rllrOCYumwg/giphy.gif[/img]

[i]The ruins in the distance! I wonder if they got any loot.[/i]


Or just use it to blow up some red barrels for style points. The choice is yours!
[img]https://media0.giphy.com/media/4bxDRGlZ9Z3ztLkxP2/giphy.gif[/img]

[i]Not actually recommended to do, but who am I to stop you.[/i]

That's all about Mirage for today.
Until next time! :B1:
